query: When do applications for admission open and close?
expected_answer: Applications open on January 11, 2027 and close on April 30, 2027.

query: What is the standard undergraduate tuition per semester?
expected_answer: PHP 42,000 per semester for 18 units.

query: What documents does a first-year applicant need to submit?
expected_answer: A completed application, senior high school report card (an interim report card may be submitted initially), proof of graduation when available, a 300-word personal statement, and one teacher recommendation.

query: How much does a shared room in the residence hall cost per month, and how many places are there?
expected_answer: PHP 4,500 per month for a shared room (excluding meals and personal expenses); the residence hall has 320 places.

query: What are the library opening hours on Saturdays?
expected_answer: 9:00 AM-5:00 PM on Saturdays during teaching weeks.

query: How many hours per week can a student work in campus employment?
expected_answer: Up to 8 hours per week (illustratively PHP 100 per hour, for up to 16 weeks per semester).

query: How much is the one-time emergency assistance grant?
expected_answer: Up to PHP 5,000 per academic year, subject to need and available funds.

query: When does Opportunity Week take place?
How many teams can receive an Undergraduate Discovery Grant and for how much each?
expected_answer: Twenty teams, each up to PHP 25,000.

query: How long is one Launchpad incubator cycle and when does it begin?
expected_answer: 12 weeks, beginning October 18, 2027.

query: Where is the Maker Room located?
expected_answer: Innovation Hall 006 (facility code MK-R).

query: When do Global Virtual Exchange applications close?
expected_answer: October 1, 2027 (without the late-transcript extension that applies to semester exchange).

query: How many recognized student organizations does the university have?
expected_answer: 38 recognized student organizations.

query: Can a student hold Access Opportunity Plus together with the Community Leadership Award?
expected_answer: No. AOP may be added only to the Access Opportunity Grant; it cannot be combined with MES or the Community Leadership Award (only one of AOG, MES or Community Leadership Award applies per semester).

query: What is the difference between the Merit Excellence Scholarship and the Merit Excellence Mobility Award?
expected_answer: The Merit Excellence Scholarship (MES) is a tuition award: 100% of standard tuition, PHP 42,000 per semester at 18 units. The Merit Excellence Mobility Award (MEM) is a separate award paying up to PHP 12,000 once per academic year for approved exchange travel (8 recipients); it is not a replacement name for MES, is not automatic, and can be held with any one main tuition award.

query: For an approved 12-unit reduced load, how much is tuition and how much does the Access Opportunity Grant cover?
expected_answer: Tuition is PHP 28,000 (PHP 2,333.33 per unit, rounded once to the nearest peso); AOG covers 50%, which is PHP 14,000.

query: A Merit Excellence Scholarship recipient took 12 units without prior approval and has an average of 96. Can they renew?
expected_answer: Not automatically. A 12-unit load without prior aid-panel approval does not qualify; the case needs panel review, because high grades do not supply the prior load approval.

query: A student created a portal outage ticket on April 1. Can they still submit the main scholarship application late?
expected_answer: No. The outage exception (finish by April 5, 2027, 5:00 PM Manila time) requires a ticket created by March 31; a ticket on April 1 missed the March 31 cutoff, so there is no automatic extension, and there is no general late-application window.

query: Can the Applied AI and Digital Inclusion Lab stay open until 8 PM on Wednesdays for a funded research team?
expected_answer: No. AI-R's extension to 8:00 PM applies only on Tuesdays and Thursdays (funded teams with written mentor and facilities approval and a named supervisor on site); normal weekday access ends at 6:00 PM.

query: A student with 54 completed units in IT and an average of 89 wants to apply for INT-027. Do they meet the requirements?
expected_answer: No. INT-027 requires 60 completed units and is not marked PILOT-48; the 48-59 unit Computing Early Placement Pilot applies only to PILOT-48 hosts such as INT-028, which this student may apply to.

query: Does the late official transcript extension also apply to Global Virtual Exchange applications?
expected_answer: No. Virtual applications close October 1, 2027 without the transcript extension; the September 24 transcript extension covers only semester-exchange applications whose main application was submitted by September 17 with a registrar delay acknowledgment.

query: A team with an original PHP 22,000 Discovery award wants to move PHP 2,500 between budget categories. Does it need Research Office approval?
expected_answer: Yes. The mentor-approved transfer limit is 10% of the original award, PHP 2,200; PHP 2,500 exceeds it, so Research Office approval is required, even if nothing has been spent.

query: Are Bayhaven Digital Works and Bayhaven Digital Workshop the same host, and which one is marked PILOT-48?
expected_answer: No, they are different hosts: Bayhaven Digital Works is a software business (INT-027) and Bayhaven Digital Workshop is a community media studio (INT-028). Only Bayhaven Digital Workshop / INT-028 is marked PILOT-48; the label does not transfer.

query: The Applied AI and Digital Inclusion Lab is closed November 8-12. Can a team book it for November 9 at 7 PM or move to the Teaching Lab at 7 PM?
expected_answer: Neither. AI-R is unavailable on November 9 because the maintenance closure overrides extended evening access, and moving to AI-T at 7 PM is not authorized: AI-T closes at 5 PM and the AI-R evening exception does not transfer.

query: Does a Discovery grant allow a team to start recruiting human participants before ethics approval is finished?
expected_answer: No. A grant and room booking do not authorize recruitment; appropriate internal ethics approval must be obtained before recruitment begins (funding approval is separate from ethics approval). Only approved non-participant preparation may proceed meanwhile.

query: A student with the Access Opportunity Grant takes a computing laboratory course. How much is payable per semester, and how much less with Access Opportunity Plus?
expected_answer: PHP 29,500 payable per semester with AOG (PHP 42,000 tuition + 6,500 service fees + 2,000 lab = 50,500, less the PHP 21,000 grant). With AOP at full benefit (up to PHP 3,000 toward service fees, if separately approved) it is PHP 26,500, i.e. up to PHP 3,000 less.

query: Which comes first, the scholarship application deadline or the admission application deadline, and may a student apply for a scholarship before being admitted?
expected_answer: The scholarship deadline (March 31, 2027) comes first; admission applications close April 30, 2027. Yes, applicants may apply for a scholarship before an admission decision (awards become active only after admission and enrollment confirmation by June 18), and missing the scholarship deadline does not prevent applying for admission until April 30.

query: Which exchange pathways exist, what are their entry requirements, and which travel awards can be combined?
expected_answer: Global Semester Exchange (24 places): 30 completed units, average 85/100, approved credit plan. Global Virtual Exchange (40 places, no travel): 15 completed units, average 80/100, separate credit approval. Travel awards: the PHP 30,000 Global Mobility Grant and the Merit Excellence Mobility Award (MEM, up to PHP 12,000) cannot be combined for the same exchange period (the student chooses one in writing); MEM can be held with any one main tuition award.

query: During a semester exchange, which tuition is payable, and which travel costs does a mobility award cover?
expected_answer: HU tuition remains payable and host tuition is waived (a home tuition scholarship may reduce eligible HU tuition). Travel, insurance, visas, housing and meals are separate costs; the host waiver does not pay airfare, housing or HU service fees. A mobility award helps with these: the Global Mobility Grant is PHP 30,000 and MEM is up to PHP 12,000 limited to approved exchange travel; the documents do not itemize exactly which costs the Global Mobility Grant covers.

query: Compare the allowance and hours of internships INT-027, INT-028 and INT-029.
expected_answer: INT-027 (Junior Web Development Intern, Bayhaven Digital Works): PHP 4,000 per month, 240 hours over 12 weeks. INT-028 (Community Media Intern, Bayhaven Digital Workshop, PILOT-48): PHP 2,500 per month, 160 hours. INT-029 (Data Quality Intern, Bayhaven Data Works): PHP 5,000 per month, 240 hours.

query: How can the Student Support Center help a research team with accessibility in the labs and the Maker Room?
expected_answer: It can coordinate accessible workstations or alternative training formats and lets students reserve accessible workstations. Access adjustments do not waive tool orientation or supervision requirements, and Maker Room equipment still requires basic tool orientation even with a research grant.

query: How many Global Mobility Grants are there, what is the deadline, and can it be combined with the Merit Excellence Mobility Award?
expected_answer: Up to 12 grants of PHP 30,000; applications close October 8, 2027. It cannot be combined with MEM for the same exchange period; if both are offered the student chooses one in writing (this does not remove an eligible tuition award).

query: Which opening hours and booking rules apply to the Applied AI and Digital Inclusion Lab for a Discovery team?
expected_answer: AI-R (Innovation Hall 204) is open weekdays 9:00 AM-6:00 PM for approved research teams. A team submits facility code, date, duration, mentor and activity at least two working days ahead; a request is a booking only after written confirmation. Maximum 2 hours per team per day (AI-R funded teams may get 4 hours with written approval); cancel at least 24 hours ahead (documented urgent illness may excuse late cancellation). Funded teams may get access until 8:00 PM on Tuesdays and Thursdays with written mentor and facilities approval and a named supervisor on site; no solo use and no weekend access.

query: When is enrollment confirmation due, when is orientation and when do classes begin?
expected_answer: Enrollment confirmation is due June 18, 2027; orientation runs August 2-6, 2027; classes begin August 9, 2027.
